selected_loci.use: Concrete kernel of degree-zero Hochschild pushforward as coinvariant differences.
Trace sums diagonal data over a quotient fibre; finite specialization proved by matrix units.
Read fully to verify the actual smooth-sheaf lifting argument and avoid importing it as an integral finite-box lifting assertion. Not used as a theorem dependency.

relevant_chapters.title: Cyclic theory and the pericyclic category

selected_loci.use: Finite pointed-set divisor pushforward and an example of keeping a bound without subgroup closure.
Actual pericyclic pullback equates the degree and Frobenius functors; it is not a finite-box CRT theorem. Read but not used as theorem dependency.
Divisor-category points retain embedded subgroups Z subset H subset Q; finite specialization H_N=(1/N)Z proved here with exact divisor inverse.
Further point quotient passes to abstract ordered groups; exact finite fibre and loss of primitive transport calculated here.
